title: Siempre que se cumpla el acuerdo: condicionales estrictas
goal: Utilize strict conditional conjunctions ('siempre que', 'con tal de que', 'a condición de que') followed by the subjunctive to articulate legal and contractual prerequisites.
grammar: Condicionales estrictas con siempre que y con tal de que

sections.title: Unit 9: Conditionals I — Lesson 4
body: Welcome to lesson 4 of Unit 9 (Conditionals I: Potential Scenarios). Mastering hypothetical conditionals enables you to explore alternatives, negotiate terms, and calibrate diplomatic courtesy.
In this lesson, we study siempre que se cumpla el acuerdo: condicionales estrictas, establishing rigorous command of imperfect subjunctive and conditional correlatives.

items: Utilize strict conditional conjunctions ('siempre que', 'con tal de que', 'a condición de que') followed by the subjunctive to articulate legal and contractual prerequisites.
Incorporate advanced negotiation vocabulary (el laudo, vinculante).
